subject: Consumer portal ledger adjustment & VAT statement needed to clear payment
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire@clearwell.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T09:14:00Z
Subject: Ledger credit applied to consumer portal — blocking payment

Hi Marissa,

Quick one — our accounts team is holding the August payment because a credit for €4,200 was applied to the consumer-portal project (acct ID CP-4421) that we didn't authorize. That credit shows up on Invoice INV-7880 and is preventing reconciliation with our internal VAT controls.

Can Redwood either reverse that ledger adjustment or provide a VAT evidence statement that explains the line so we can file and release payment? Our AP needs either: (1) corrected invoice without the unexplained credit, or (2) clear VAT supporting docs that tie the credit to a tax-exempt adjustment.

We're aiming to get this cleared before the end of the month — can you confirm next steps and an ETA?

Thanks,
Claire Donovan
Head of Finance Ops
ClearWell Health
Attachments: screenshot-ledger-line.png (png, 120kb)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@clearwell.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Ledger credit applied to consumer portal — blocking payment

Hi Claire — thank you for flagging this. I'm sorry for the confusion and appreciate the clear ask.

Short plan of action:
- I will work with Billing (Ben) to either reverse the ledger credit or issue a reissued invoice.
- Hannah will confirm the VAT treatment and produce a VAT statement tying the adjustment to the original service lines.
- We'll produce a reissued invoice (no unexplained credit) + a VAT certificate, or provide an explanatory statement if reversal isn't possible.

Ben / Hannah — can one of you confirm whether the €4,200 credit came from a manual goodwill adjustment in July? If so, we need to: (a) document the reason for tax purposes, and (b) decide whether to reissue INV-7880 or issue a correcting invoice INV-7894.

Claire — ETA: I expect a status update within 24 hours and final docs within 48 business hours. If you need a faster turnaround we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Finance (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
Phone: +44 20 7946 0820
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T13:19:00Z
Subject: Re: Ledger credit applied to consumer portal — blocking payment

Marissa — quick internal note. I pulled the ledger and the €4,200 entry was a goodwill adjustment applied on 2026-07-28 for CP-4421 (internal ticket CS-1139). It was applied to offset a customer-reported ingest issue; that explains why it's not an invoice-level refund but a ledger credit.

Options:
1) Reverse the goodwill ledger credit (preferred for ClearWell's AP) — this is a fast accounting entry and we can re-open the original monthly close to remove it.
2) Issue a corrective invoice (INV-7894) that shows the original lines and no goodwill credit.

Tax/VAT note: Hannah — if we reverse the credit, do we need a formal VAT correction memo or is the reversal sufficient (EU rules)? Naomi can help draft a VAT evidence statement for the customer's files.

I'll standby and can action reversal once Marissa signs off.

Ben Carter
Senior Billing Analyst
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ledger-extract-CP-4421.csv (csv)
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-19T15:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Ledger credit applied to consumer portal — VAT handling

Ben / Marissa — per EU VAT guidance, reversing a goodwill credit that reduced taxable revenue typically requires a VAT correction note if the original credit affected a previously issued invoice's taxable base. That said, because the credit was applied at ledger level (not a formal credit note presented to the customer), the safest customer-facing approach is to: (A) reissue a corrected invoice (INV-7894) without the credit, and (B) include a VAT statement certifying the reversal and referencing CS-1139.

I've drafted a two-page VAT statement that explains the reason, date, and accounting treatment; Naomi will attach the customer-facing version once we confirm the amount.

I'll plan to: create VAT statement + attest the reversal reference. Marissa — approve reissue and we'll attach the Statement and our VAT certification.

Hannah Schmitt
Tax Manager (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@clearwell.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-21T09:37:00Z
Subject: Action: reissued invoice and VAT statement for CP-4421 (INV-7894)

Hi Claire — following internal review here's what we'll deliver to clear the outstanding payment hold:

1) Reissued invoice: INV-7894 (replaces INV-7880) — the reissue removes the unexplained ledger credit so the invoice total matches ClearWell's expectation.
2) VAT statement & certification: PDF explaining the accounting reversal and referencing internal ticket CS-1139 (Hannah Schmitt).
3) Goodwill concession: as a gesture of goodwill for the disruption, Redwood will apply a one-time courtesy adjustment of €1,000 on the next invoice — this concession is separate from the ledger reversal and will be explicitly documented for tax purposes.

Attachments included: INV-7894-reissued.pdf (reissued invoice), vat-certification-clearwell.pdf (VAT statement and attestation), m_a_p-clearwell.xlsx (mutual action plan with dates for reconciliation).

Payment instructions: please pay the reissued invoice INV-7894 to the same bank coordinates indicated on the invoice. If AP prefers a cleared-payment confirmation email after transfer, we will confirm receipt within one business day of funds hitting our account.

If that plan works, please confirm and we'll send the DocuSign waiver for the courtesy concession (internal approval completed).

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Finance (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: INV-7894-reissued.pdf (pdf), vat-certification-clearwell.pdf (pdf), m_a_p-clearwell.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Claire Donovan <claire@clearwell.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@clearwell.com
Date: 2026-08-21T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Action: reissued invoice and VAT statement for CP-4421 (INV-7894)

Thanks Marissa — that plan is fine. We'll release payment once we receive INV-7894 and the VAT statement you attached. Expect payment within five business days after documents are uploaded to our portal. Please send the DocuSign for the courtesy concession and confirm the payee IBAN on the invoice.

Claire Donovan
Head of Finance Ops
ClearWell Health
